བར་དོ: the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
བསྟན་པ: teaching, showing (bstan, past of ston 'show', + pa)
བཞུགས་སོ: is present, is here (bzhugs, respectful for 'to sit, to stay', + the sentence-ending -so)
ནི: as for: marks the topic of the sentence
བྱ: is to be done; called (bya, future of byed 'do'): zhes bya 'is called' · with 'I' as the doer: 'I shall do' (bya, future of byed), as in ngo shes bya 'I shall recognise'
སྟེ: and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
དེ: that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
ཡང: also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
ལ: to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …')
འཕྲང: narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
བཞིན་དུ: just as, like (bzhin 'like' + -du); after a verb 'while, as': sngar bzhin du 'as before'
ངོ་སྤྲད་པས: by being pointed out (ngo sprad 'point out' + -pa + -s 'by')
ཅིག: one, a (gcig written without its prefix g-)
མ: not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!' · mother (ma): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
འཕྲོད: to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
ཀྱང: also, even, though (the form of yang after g, d, b, s)
གཅིག: one; a, a certain · perhaps 'together, at once' (as gcig 'one' in 'od drug kyang gcig 'char du 'ong 'the six lights also dawn together'); the sense is not sure
གྲོལ་བ: being freed, liberation (grol + ba, which makes a verb into a noun)
ཐོབ་པ: one who has gained (thob 'to get, to attain' + pa)
འབྱུང་ངོ: occurs, arises ('byung 'occur' + the sentence-ending -ngo): mang du 'byung ngo 'occur in great number'
བྱུང: came about, happened, occurred (byung, past of 'byung)
ཚན་ཆེ: strong, of great force (tshan che; read so)
སྡིག་སྒྲིབ: sinful obscuration, the veil that harmful deeds leave on the mind (sdig 'sin' + sgrib 'obscuration')
བག་ཆགས: habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
ཡུན་རིང: long time, a long duration (yun 'duration' + ring 'long')
ཅིང: and, while (links two verbs; also shing, zhing)
མེད་པས: because there is not (med 'there is not' + -pas 'because')
ངོ་སྤྲད: pointing out, face-introduction (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod 'point out')
གྲོལ་བར: to be freed, that one will be freed (grol ba + -r)
དང: and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
རིག་འཛིན: knowledge-holder (rig pa 'knowledge' + 'dzin 'hold'; Sanskrit vidyādhara): a master of tantric knowledge
ཀྱི: of (the form used after d, b, s; also gyi, gi, -'i, yi) · in this print perhaps also written where kyis 'by' is meant (khyod kyi gong du, read as khyod kyis)
བསུ་བ: meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
གོང: above, before, earlier (gong 'above'); gong gi 'the one above'
གི: of (the form used after g, ng); in this print also written where gis 'by' is meant · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows ('ong gi 'comes, and')
གནས: to remain, to stay; a place
འཆར་དུ: to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
འོང་བས: because it comes, since it will come ('ong 'come' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
མི: not (before present and future verbs) · person, human being (mi): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has known'
འཇིགས: to fear, to be afraid ('jigs); fear
སྐྲག: to be frightened, to be terrified (skrag); fright
དངངས: dread, to be terrified (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'be terrified')
གྱི: of (the form used after n, m, r, l)
འགྲོ: to go, goes ('gro, present; past song or phyin, imperative song)
ངོ: face; the nature or identity of a thing
འཕྲོད་པ: meeting, recognition ('phrod 'to meet' + -pa): ngo 'phrod pa 'the recognition'
རིག་པ: knowing, awareness itself, before any thought
འོང: comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
ཟིན: seized, caught; held (zin, the intransitive verb beside 'dzin 'to hold'): ngos zin 'recognise'
ནས: from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
ཕྱིར: outside, outward(?). The reading is uncertain; another print has dri med, 'stainless', here · here plainly 'out, outward' (phyi 'outside' + -r): phyir log 'turn back out', phyir thon 'come out' · back: phyir mi ldog go 'does not turn back' (phyir 'back' + ldog 'turn')
ཞེ: so, thus (zhe, the form zhes takes before na after ng, n, m, r, l, ' and a vowel; ce na after g, d, b, she na after s): gang zhe na 'if one asks which', the way a list is opened
ན: if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
སྣང་བ: appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
ཤར་བས: because it has arisen, as (it has) arisen (shar, past of 'char 'arise', + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because'); ma shar bas 'because it has not yet arisen'
རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: one-pointedly, with a single mind (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one' + -tu)
ལྟ་བུའི: like, of the kind of (lta bu 'like' + -'i): me long lta bu'i 'like a mirror'
འཕྲད: to meet, to come upon ('phrad): X dang 'phrad 'to meet with X'
ལྟ་བུ: like, of the kind of (lta bu)
འདིར: here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
འཛིན་པའི: of holding, that holds ('dzin 'hold' + -pa + -'i 'of'): cha 'dzin pa'i 'holding the part (of)'
རྣམས: plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
འཁོར་བར: in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
བྲོས་པས: because it has fled (bros pa, past of 'bros 'run away', + -s)
ཐ་མ: lowest, last (tha ma): tha ma'i yang tha ma 'the lowest even of the lowest'
འདྲིས: familiar, familiarity ('dris): sngar 'dris med pa 'without earlier familiarity'
འཕྲད་པ: meeting ('phrad 'meet' + -pa): ma dang bu 'phrad pa 'mother and child meeting'
ཡིན་པར: that it is, as being (yin pa 'being' + -r 'as, that'): X yin par shes 'know that it is X'
ཤེས: to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
ཏེ: and, and so: links a verb to what follows (te, the form of ste after n, r, l; this print also writes it after other letters)
གཉིས་སུ: into two, as two (gnyis 'two' + -su): gnyis su med par 'without being two, non-dually'
སངས་རྒྱས་པར: to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
མི་ཡུལ་དུ: in the human world, in the land of humans (mi 'person' + yul 'land' + -du 'in')
མངོན་རྟོགས: clear realisation, the text describing a deity to be visualised (mngon 'clear' + rtogs 'realise')
ལ་སོགས: and so on, etcetera (la sogs: la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera')
མཐོང་བ: seeing (mthong 'see' + -ba): mthong ba tsam gyis 'by merely seeing'
གནད: vital point, key point (gnad): the place where a thing is decided, like a pressure point on the body
ཞིང: and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing) · realm, field; a buddha-field (zhing, short for zhing khams): dag pa'i zhing 'pure realm'
ཆོས: thing, phenomenon; the teaching (Sanskrit dharma) · reality, what is true (chos): chos kyi rang sgra 'the own sound of reality'
ལ་སོགས་པའི: of those and the like, and so on (la sogs pa + -'i 'of')
གིས: by (the form used after g, ng) · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows, as gi does ('ong gis 'comes, and')
བར་དོར: in the bardo (bar do + -r 'in, into') · as the bardo: the -r marks what a thing is recognised as (bar dor ngo shes 'recognise as the bardo')
ཤར: arisen, appeared (shar, past of 'char 'arise') · the east (shar): dkyil 'khor de'i shar nas 'from the east of that maṇḍala'
སྐྱེས: arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
རྐྱེན: condition, circumstance, cause (rkyen): rkyen gyis 'through the force of'
བྱས: did, made, having done (byas, past of byed 'do')
ངན་སོང་དུ: into the lower realms, bad destinies (ngan song 'bad going' + -du 'into')
འཛིན་པ: grasping, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa): the mind taking hold of what it sees · holding with compassion (thugs rjes 'dzin pa)
ནང: inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'
ནའང: even if (na 'if' + 'ang 'even'): yin na'ang 'even if it is'
འདུག: to sit, to stay; in speech 'is, there is', like yod; after a verb also 'seems' ('dug)
ཐུབ: able (thub, to be able, to be capable of)
ཙམ: just, only, about · as much as, so much that (tsam): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'so loud as to split the head'
དེས་ན: so, therefore, in that case (des 'by that' + na 'if, when')
ཆེ་བའི: of the greater, senior (che ba 'great' + -'i 'of') · of great, in whom … is great (sdig sgrib che ba'i gang zag 'persons of heavy sinful obscurations')
ཡན་ཆད: from … upward, and everything above (yan chad): de yan chad 'that and all above it'
ལ་སོགས་པ: and the like, and so on (la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera' + -pa)
ཆོས་ཉིད: reality itself, the true nature of things (chos 'thing' + nyid 'itself'; Sanskrit dharmatā)
ཙམ་དུ: just so far, just to the point of (tsam + du)
མར: down, downward (mar, the opposite of yar 'up'); of time, 'on, onward' · butter (mar), another word of the same spelling
ཆད: to stop, to be cut off
མ་ཁད་དུ: as soon as, the moment that
དཔའ་བོ: hero (dpa' bo; Sanskrit vīra): in the tantras the male companions of the sky-goer women
མཁའ་འགྲོ: sky-goer, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go'; also written mkha' 'gro ma, with the feminine -ma)
ལ་སོགས་པས: by ... and so on, and the like (la sogs pa 'et cetera' + -s 'by')
འོད་དུ: in light, into light ('od 'light' + -du): 'ja' dang 'od du 'in rainbow and light'
ཟེར: say, call (zer 'say, speak') · ray, ray of light (zer), as in 'od zer, and sgra 'od zer gsum 'sound, light and rays'
ཐོས་གྲོལ: liberation through hearing (thos 'hear' + grol 'be freed'); the Tibetan name of this book
ཆེན་མོ: great (chen 'big', with the feminine ending often used in titles)
ཕྱག་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ: Great Seal, mahāmudrā: the realisation of the mind's nature (phyag rgya 'seal' + chen po 'great')
དག: pure, correct · plural marker after de: de dag 'those, these'
འཆི་ཁའི: of the point of death ('chi kha 'the brink of death' + -'i 'of')
འོད་གསལ: clear light, luminosity: the nature of mind, said to show itself bare at death ('od 'light' + gsal 'clear')
ཆོས་སྐུ: the body of truth, a buddha as reality itself, without form (chos + sku 'body'; Sanskrit dharmakāya)
ཞི་ཁྲོའི: of the peaceful and wrathful ones (zhi khro + -'i 'of')
སྤྲུལ་སྐུ: the body of emanation, a buddha appearing in flesh and blood (sprul 'emanate' + sku; Sanskrit nirmāṇakāya; the word 'tulku')
ལས་འཕྲོ: karmic residue (las 'karma' + 'phro 'remainder'): what is left over of past deeds and goes on working; in this text the good karma from past lives that ties a person to the teaching
གྱིས: do! (imperative of byed 'to do'); spelled the same as gyis 'by' · by (the 'by' ending as a free word after n, m, r, l): las bzang ngan gyis 'by good or bad karma'
བྱེ་བྲག: kind, sort, variety (bye brag): rol mo'i bye brag 'kinds of music'
སྲིད་དོ: can be, is possible (srid 'be possible' + the sentence-ending -do): mi srid 'it cannot be, it is impossible'
